name: Castaways
source:
You and your roomates get free cruise tickets.
Escape from a GrimDark crapsack world to a FunBright SexyFlaps adventure
A light hearted game with humor
Talk to people to know what they will give sexually
Gain affection and have sex with who you want.
translation:
你和室友們拿到了免費的郵輪船票。
逃離那個陰暗殘酷、爛透了的世界，奔赴一場陽光明媚、春光外洩的冒險！
這是一款輕鬆幽默的遊戲。
跟人聊聊，看看他們在床上願意為你做什麼。
培養好感，想和誰做愛，就和誰做愛。
